* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Jizzy.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Jizzy|Jizzy]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Woozie.png]]Woozie's office, Chinatown, San Fierro
|}

After the cutscene, drive round the block to the alley. Follow Woozie to trigger another cutscene. Now you have to get out of the alley alive. If Woozie dies, you fail the mission. Once you get back in the car, some enemy cars chase you. Just drive Woozie back to his office to complete the mission.

== Rewards ==
* '''Cash''': $5,000
* '''Respect''': +10
